references.text: The people reaffirm their commitment to serve the Lord
The first commandment forbids having other gods besides the Lord
The command to fear the Lord and not follow other gods
The warning against following other gods and holding fast to the Lord
Jacob asks his household to remove foreign gods, similar to a cleansing
Samuel urges Israel to turn away from foreign gods and serve the Lord alone
Israel confesses their sin of having abandoned the Lord to serve other gods
Elijah challenges the people to choose between the Lord and Baal
Joshua's earlier exhortation to stay away from foreign gods
Warning against turning away from the Lord to serve the gods of other nations
